reference.code: use std::collections::BTreeMap;fn key(s:&str)->bool{let mut p=s.split('-');p.all(|x|!x.is_empty()&&x.as_bytes()[0].is_ascii_lowercase()&&x.bytes().all(|c|c.is_ascii_lowercase()||c.is_ascii_digit()))}pub fn tag_patch(input:&str)->Option<String>{if input.matches(';').count()!=1{return None}let(base,ops)=input.split_once(';')?;let mut d=BTreeMap::new();if !base.is_empty(){for r in base.split(','){let(k,v)=r.split_once('=')?;if !key(k)||d.insert(k.to_string(),v.to_string()).is_some(){return None}}}if !ops.is_empty(){for op in ops.split(','){if let Some(x)=op.strip_prefix("set:"){let(k,v)=x.split_once('=')?;if !key(k){return None}d.insert(k.into(),v.into());}else if let Some(k)=op.strip_prefix("unset:"){if !key(k){return None}d.remove(k);}else{return None}}}Some(d.into_iter().map(|(k,v)|k+"="+&v).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}
